title: Connected agents
native.body: Connect or disconnect your own AI agents from the web version of your profile.
scope.context.label: Course position
scope.context.detail: the course, your current lesson and its objectives
scope.profile.label: Your stated preferences
scope.profile.detail: pace, explanation style, prior knowledge you wrote, suggestions you accepted
scope.evidence.label: Your progress evidence
scope.evidence.detail: what your answers show per objective, without anything you excluded
scope.history.label: Your question history
scope.history.detail: your own questions and answer outcomes in a lesson
scope.propose_intervention.label: Suggest changes
scope.propose_intervention.detail: suggestions that wait for your review here; they never give credit
error.AGENT_GRANT_LIMIT: You already have the most connected agents allowed for this course. Disconnect one first.
error.connect: The agent could not be connected. Nothing changed. Try again.
error.disconnect: "{label}" could not be disconnected. Try again.
intro: Let an AI agent you use elsewhere read parts of your record for {course} and suggest changes for you to review.
token.created: Connected “{label}”. Copy this key into your agent now; it's shown only once. If you lose it, disconnect and connect again.
token.label: Access key
token.copyFailed: This page can't copy for you on this connection. The key is selected: copy it with Ctrl+C (⌘C on a Mac) or your device's copy menu.
token.usage: Agents send it as {header} to {mcp} (MCP) or {rest}.
form.name: Name for this agent
unavailable: Your connected agents could not be loaded right now.
form.limits: You choose what it may read and for how long, and you can disconnect it at any time. It can't answer checks, change your progress, or see your private notes, your course team's notes or other learners.
